sections.head: Screenshots, visual diffs and real devices

items.a: Responsive testing checks that a website's layout adapts correctly to different screen sizes and devices.

items.q: Is responsive testing on real devices better than resizing my browser?
items.a: Yes for sign-off. Resizing shows desktop rendering at a small width; real devices show Safari, Chrome and fonts as users see them.

items.q: Can I test a local site?
items.a: Yes. The UnderPass tunnel opens localhost and staging on the cloud devices.
The free plan gives 1 parallel test with monthly live sessions, and the Responsive Checker gives quick previews.

items.q: How do I catch layout changes automatically?
items.a: Use SmartUI visual regression testing to compare each build's screenshots against a baseline.
